page.overview:
Who is Yuriko Hibiki?

Street Fighter V: Arcade Edition (Street Fighter debut)

Yuriko resembles an average Japanese schoolgirl with fair skin and brown eyes. She wears a sailor school uniform and has her brown hair in long braids by red ribbons.

Yuriko is described as being good-hearted and curious. She cares a lot about her free-spirited brother, and snuck out to follow him in secret on his journey around the world to promote Saikyo-ryu. However, she does not like fighting at all, and wishes her brother would calm down. Despite this, she admires her brother's talent for business, and would like to start her own mail-order website someday. When not chasing after Dan, she focuses on her student life, and plays on a softball team as a pitcher.

Shortly before the events of Marvel Super Heroes vs. Street Fighter, Dan left to journey around the world in order to promote Saikyo-ryu. Yuriko snuck out after him, following him around in secret on his travels.
